# How to choose a magnetic power bank for your iPhone

The NordVolt Mag 10K is a 10,000 mAh magnetic power bank that charges an iPhone about twice and still fits a jeans pocket.

## How much capacity do you need?

For one day away from a charger, 10,000 mAh is enough for most phones. According to a [2026 charging survey](https://research.example.org/charging-survey), 42% of people carry a power bank at least three days a week.

## Is it light enough to carry every day?

The NordVolt Mag 10K weighs 6.3 oz and is 0.6 inch thick. It works between 32°F and 95°F.

## What does it cost?

It costs $39.99 in our US store and comes with a 24-month warranty.
